strings.text: LANGKAU LAWATAN
strings.src: SKIP THE TOUR

strings.text: Semasa tutup, sewa keluar semula dari situ. Halakan tetikus pada wang untuk bil malam ini.
strings.src: At closing the rent comes back out of it. Hover over the money for tonight's bill.

strings.text: Tutup tiga malam berturut-turut dalam rugi, dan premis ini gelap semula.
strings.src: End three nights running in the red and this room goes dark again.

strings.text: Lupa cara buat minuman? Menu di kaunter ada setiap halaman yang kita tuang.
strings.src: Forgot how a drink goes? The menu on the counter has every page we pour.

strings.text: Masa merangkak bila buku terbuka, tapi tak pernah berhenti. Klik di luar buku untuk tutup.
strings.src: The night crawls while it's open, but it never stops. Click off the book to close it.

strings.text: {drink} bermula dengan {bottle}. Ambil dari rak.
strings.src: {drink} starts with {bottle}. Take it off the shelf.

strings.text: Yang ini TUANG TERUS. Tak perlu goncang, seret saja penutup ke atas tin.
strings.src: This one is built. No shaking, just drag the lid onto the tin.

strings.text: Nama, umur, dan minuman yang mereka cari. Pesanan hanya ada pada kad.
strings.src: Name, age, and the drink they came for. The order only ever lives on the card.

strings.text: Tulisan halus itu penting nanti. Malam ini, semua orang memang seperti yang mereka kata.
strings.src: The fine print will matter later. Tonight, everybody's who they say they are.

strings.text: Klik di mana-mana di luar kad untuk simpan. Resipi yang dipin kekal di situ.
strings.src: Click anywhere off the card to put it away. The pinned recipe stays.

strings.text: Setiap minuman bermula dari kabinet di bawah kaunter. Bukalah.
strings.src: Every drink starts in the cellar under the counter. Open it up.

strings.text: Itu jamnya. Satu malam berjalan dari pukul enam hingga dua pagi.
strings.src: That's the clock. A night runs from six till two in the morning.

strings.text: Bila masa tamat, pintu ditutup, dan sesiapa di dalam habiskan minuman mereka.
strings.src: When it runs out the door shuts, and whoever's in finishes their drink.

strings.text: Esc menjeda malam. Tetapan ada di situ.
strings.src: Escape pauses the night. The settings are in there.

strings.text: Bila pintu ditutup, keluar resit malam ini, kemudian pasar: botol, halaman dan perabot.
strings.src: When the door shuts, the night's slip comes up, then the market: bottles, pages and fittings.

strings.text: Itulah kerjanya, sugar. Pintu ini milik anda.
strings.src: That's the job, sugar. The door is yours.

strings.text: Sekarang biar mereka habiskan. Tiada siapa suka digesa.
strings.src: Now let them finish. Nobody likes being rushed.

strings.text: Mereka tinggalkan gelas, dan bangku dengan gelas kotor di depannya takkan diduduki.
strings.src: They leave the glass behind, and a stool with a dirty glass in front of it seats nobody.

strings.text: Seret gelas itu ke singki.
strings.src: Drag that glass into the sink.

strings.text: Ini tetamu pertama anda. Beri mereka sekejap untuk buat keputusan.
strings.src: Here's your first guest. Give them a second to make up their mind.

strings.text: Sekarang serahkan. Seret gelas ke tetamu anda, atau klik saja mereka.
strings.src: Now hand it over. Drag the glass to your guest, or just click them.

strings.text: Halakan tetikus pada bintang. Hati tunjuk bagaimana minuman diterima, berlian tunjuk selesanya premis.
strings.src: Hover over the stars. Hearts are how the drinks went down, diamonds how the room feels.

strings.text: Malam dinilai ikut yang lebih rendah, jadi jaga kedua-duanya.
strings.src: The night is filed at the lower of the two, so mind both.

strings.text: Tin tunjuk apa isinya. Buku menyalakan kotak tempat setiap botol patut masuk.
strings.src: The tin shows what's in it. The book lights the box each bottle lands in.

strings.text: Hampir tepat pun cukup malam ini. Tip untuk yang tepat betul.
strings.src: Close is fine tonight. Dead on is what the tips are for.

strings.text: Sekarang {bottle}. Kembali ke bar dengan anak panah, ambil dari kabinet dan tuang.
strings.src: Now the {bottle}. Back to the bar with the arrow, take it from the cellar and pour it in.

strings.text: Jalur di atas kepala mereka itu kesabaran. Bila habis, mereka pun pergi.
strings.src: That bar over their head is patience. Once it's gone, so are they.

strings.text: Malam ini, semasa saya bawa anda melihat-lihat, ia menunggu anda. Selepas itu, tidak.
strings.src: Tonight, while I'm showing you round, it waits for you. After that it won't.

strings.text: Pegang botol dan condongkan ke atas tin. Makin tinggi diangkat, makin laju ia mengalir.
strings.src: Grab the bottle and tip it over the tin. The higher you lift it, the faster it runs.

strings.text: Tengok muka mereka. Itulah ulasannya, dan ia masuk ke dalam bintang.
strings.src: Watch their face. That's the review, and it goes into the stars.

strings.text: Mereka bayar bila bangun. Tip bergantung pada kelajuan, kemahiran dan isian yang elok.
strings.src: They pay when they get up. The tip rides on speed, craft and a good fill.

strings.text: Dah puas hati? HIDANGKAN letak gelas di atas kaunter.
strings.src: Happy with it? SERVE IT puts the glass on the counter.

strings.text: Bintang itu apa kata orang di jalan tentang kita. Lebih bintang, lebih besar bar.
strings.src: Those stars are what the street says about us. More stars, more bar.

strings.text: Bintang membuka botol yang bagus, halaman yang lebih baik dan perabot di pasar.
strings.src: They open the good bottles, the better pages, the fittings in the market.

strings.text: Tiada siapa beritahu apa mereka mahu. Klik bangku mereka dan baca kad.
strings.src: Nobody tells you what they want. Click their stool and read the card.

strings.text: Itu menara bir. Bir ada seninya sendiri. Saya tunjuk bila ada yang pesan.
strings.src: That's the tap. Beer is a craft of its own. I'll show you when somebody asks.

strings.text: Laci duit. Setiap minuman yang anda jual masuk ke sini, tip sekali.
strings.src: The till. Every drink you sell lands in here, tips and all.

strings.text: Pegang tin dan condongkan ke atas gelas. Apa yang tersasar dari gelas, hilang.
strings.src: Grab the tin and tip it over the glass. Whatever misses the glass is gone.

strings.text: Itu pun anda, sugar. Pintu dibuka pukul enam. Biar saya bawa anda melihat-lihat dulu.
strings.src: There you are, sugar. The doors open at six. Let me walk you round first.

strings.text: Ambil masa anda. Tiada apa di sini bergerak semasa saya bercakap.
strings.src: Take your time. Nothing in here moves while I'm talking.

strings.text: Dan kesan bulatan pada kayu itu. Kaunter kotor buat premis hilang berlian.
strings.src: And that ring on the wood. A dirty counter costs you the room's diamonds.

strings.text: Ambil kain lap dan gosok sampai hilang.
strings.src: Grab the cloth and rub it out.

strings.text: LANGKAU
strings.src: SKIP THIS

strings.text: Salah tuang? BUANG akan kosongkan tin. Ada kosnya sedikit, jadi sasar dulu.
strings.src: Pour it wrong? The bin tips the tin out. It costs a little, so aim first.

strings.text: Pintu ini milik anda sekarang, sugar. Semak umur: bawah dua puluh, tak boleh minum di sini.
strings.src: The door is yours now, sugar. Check the age: under twenty, they don't drink here.

strings.text: Tengok kad itu sendiri. Bendera yang bukan negaranya, muka yang bukan mukanya, kad yang nampak dilukis: itu palsu.
strings.src: Look at the card itself. A flag that isn't their country, a face that isn't theirs, a card that looks drawn: that's a fake.

strings.text: HALAU tunjukkan mereka pintu keluar. Kalau betul, bandar berterima kasih semasa tutup.
strings.src: KICK shows them the door. Get it right and the city thanks you at closing.

strings.text: Tuang untuk budak, anda bayar denda. Halau orang jujur, anda hilang seorang tetamu.
strings.src: Pour for a kid and you pay the fine. Throw out an honest face and you lose a guest.

strings.text: Perkara kecil. Mereka beri tip untuk perkara kecil. Sekarang serahkan.
strings.src: Little things. They tip for little things. Now hand it over.

strings.text: Mereka minta {garnish}. Seret dari piringnya ke atas gelas.
strings.src: They asked for {garnish}. Drag it from its dish onto the glass.

strings.text: Halakan tetikus pada nama minuman, resipinya muncul di sebelah.
strings.src: Hover over the drink's name and its recipe comes up beside it.

strings.text: Diamkan tetikus sekejap, resipi akan berhenti. Pin mengekalkannya di skrin semasa anda bekerja.
strings.src: Hold still a moment and it settles. The pin keeps it up on the screen while you work.

strings.text: Bibir gelas siap. Sekarang serahkan.
strings.src: That's a rim. Now hand it over.

strings.text: Mereka mahu {garnish}. Pegang piring dan putarkan sekali keliling bibir gelas.
strings.src: They want {garnish}. Hold the dish and run it once round the rim of the glass.

strings.text: Tutup dulu. Seret penutup ke atas tin.
strings.src: Cap it first. Drag the lid onto the tin.

strings.text: Itulah goncangan. Ke gelas, sama seperti tadi.
strings.src: That's a shake. Over to the glass, same as before.

strings.text: Sekarang pegang tin, tahan butang dan goncang ke depan ke belakang sampai lajur MIX penuh.
strings.src: Now grab the tin, hold the button and shake it back and forth until the MIX column fills.

strings.text: Yang ini digoncang. Ia perlukan ais dan udara, bukan sudu.
strings.src: This one is shaken. It wants ice and air through it, not a spoon.

strings.text: Senarai di kiri bawa anda melalui minuman ini. Setiap langkah ditanda bila anda buat.
strings.src: The list on the left walks you through the drink. Each step ticks off as you do it.

strings.text: Sutera, bukan buih. Tutup dan bawa ke gelas.
strings.src: Silk, not foam. Cap it and take it over.

strings.text: Yang ini dikacau, bukan digoncang. Ambil sudu dan buat bulatan di atas tin yang terbuka.
strings.src: This one is stirred, not shaken. Take the spoon and work circles over the open tin.

strings.text: Satu lagi sebelum saya biar anda bekerja.
strings.src: One more thing before I let you work.
